key_finding: Full gateway pipeline source-proven: IMAP/POP polling via fetchmail.server → message_process entry point → three-step routing (reply/alias/fallback) → _routing_check_route alias_contact enforcement → _message_route_process record creation. MTA pipe path via odoo-mailgate.py XML-RPC also proven. All three AWT paths (IMAP poll, MTA pipe, contact-security) require runtime execution to close GAP-039.

awt_plans.title: IMAP/POP polling path
steps: Create fetchmail.server with IMAP credentials pointing to test mailbox; confirm login; verify state=done
Send RFC2822 email from external client to the test mailbox address
Trigger _fetch_mails manually or wait 5-minute cron cycle
Verify: new mail.message created under correct model/thread_id; alias_status=valid on matched alias

awt_plans.title: MTA pipe (odoo-mailgate.py) path
steps: Configure postfix/sendmail alias pipe to odoo-mailgate.py with correct --host/--port/-d/-u/-p args
Send RFC2822 email to alias address (e.g. support@example.com)
Verify: script exits 0; new mail.message / record created in Odoo

awt_plans.title: alias_contact enforcement (followers)
steps: Set alias_contact=followers on a mail.alias; send email from non-follower address
Verify: bounce email returned to sender; alias_status unchanged (not config error); record NOT created
Set alias_contact=partners; send email from unknown address (no res.partner match)
Verify: bounce returned; record not created
